# `adi-facts` — types

> The fact base: plain sentences an agent can write in bulk, with a derivation graph that makes anything built on a changed fact go stale. Pure library — `adi-mono facts` is its CLI.

## `src/error.rs`

### enum `Error`

Errors this crate returns.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("cannot parse fact base id: {0}")]
    BadBaseId(String),
    #[error("no such fact base: {0}")]
    NoSuchBase(String),
    #[error("{reader} may not {verb} {base}")]
    Denied {
        reader: String,
        verb: &'static str,
        base: String,
    },
    #[error("no such transaction: {0}")]
    NoSuchTransaction(String),
    #[error("no such pair p{pair} in {tx}")]
    NoSuchPair {
        tx: String,
        pair: i64,
    },
    #[error("no such fact: {0}")]
    NoSuchFact(String),
    #[error( "merge needs --fact: the one sentence that says what both say.\n left: {left}\n right: {right}" )]
    MergeNeedsFact {
        left: String,
        right: String,
    },
    #[error("supersede needs --keep: the winner, {left} or {right}")]
    SupersedeNeedsKeep {
        left: String,
        right: String,
    },
    #[error("--keep {keep} is neither side of p{pair}. It must be {left} or {right}.")]
    KeepIsNotASide {
        keep: String,
        pair: i64,
        left: String,
        right: String,
    },
    #[error("cannot commit: {count} pair(s) still open — {pairs}")]
    StillOpen {
        count: usize,
        pairs: String,
    },
    #[error("{tx} is {state}; nothing further can be done to it")]
    TransactionClosed {
        tx: String,
        state: String,
    },
    #[error("embedding failed: {0}")]
    Embed(String),
    #[error("the model could not be reached: {0}")]
    Judge(String),
    #[error("fact base: {0}")]
    Backend(String),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Config(adi_config::Error),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(std::io::Error),
}
```

### type `Result`

The result type every fallible call in this crate returns.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```
